raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines, each representing a method: Base (black, solid, circles), MEND (brown, solid, squares), FT (blue, solid, triangles), MEMIT (purple, solid, diamonds), IKE (red, solid, triangles), and ROME (green, solid, squares). The Base line starts around 40% at Co-occurrence Number 1 and increases to around 44% at 10^3. The MEND line starts around 44% and increases to around 56%. The FT line starts around 42% and increases to around 48%. The MEMIT line starts around 45% and increases to around 54%. The IKE line starts around 43% and increases to around 50%. The ROME line starts around 52% and increases to around 65%.
